mobile_voice_announce_background: Screen reader announcement after the app left the foreground while dictating; the text said so far is kept.
mobile_voice_announce_cap: Screen reader announcement when the 5-minute cap stops dictation; the text said so far is kept.
mobile_voice_announce_discarded: Screen reader announcement after the X.
mobile_voice_announce_inserted: Screen reader announcement after the dictated text went into the message.
mobile_voice_announce_started: Screen reader announcement when the microphone goes live.
mobile_voice_announce_stopped: Screen reader announcement when the person taps the check and dictation stops.
mobile_voice_answer_allowed: Snackbar after the crew server allowed a tool call from a spoken answer
mobile_voice_answer_busy: Shown when a voice answer is started while dictation or another voice answer holds the microphone
mobile_voice_answer_button: Button on an approval or choice card that starts dictating the answer
mobile_voice_answer_chose: Snackbar after the crew server answered a choice card from a spoken answer; {choice} is the option's text
mobile_voice_answer_comment: Note under an approval after a spoken answer that is only a comment; {text} is the transcript
mobile_voice_answer_denied: Snackbar after the crew server denied a tool call from a spoken answer
mobile_voice_answer_hint_approval: Screen reader hint of the Answer by voice button on a tool approval
mobile_voice_answer_hint_choice: Screen reader hint of the Answer by voice button on a choice card
mobile_voice_answer_send: Screen reader label of the check that sends a spoken answer to the crew server
mobile_voice_answer_sending: Shown while a spoken answer waits for the crew server's verdict
mobile_voice_answer_tap_bypass: Note when the crew server refuses to allow by voice because the crewmate is in Bypass mode
mobile_voice_answer_tap_destructive: Note when the crew server refuses to allow by voice because the call is destructive (rm -rf, force push, DROP TABLE...)
mobile_voice_answer_tap_other: Note when voice cannot answer this kind of card (a secret, a refused task)
mobile_voice_answer_tap_rail: Note when the crew server refuses to allow by voice because a rail (protected path, never-auto task) holds the call
mobile_voice_answer_tap_untrusted: Note when the crew server does not trust the source of a spoken answer
mobile_voice_answer_unclear_approval: Note under an approval when the spoken answer meant nothing
mobile_voice_answer_unclear_choice: Note under a choice card when the spoken answer matched no option
mobile_voice_dictate: Screen reader label of the microphone button in the composer of a crewmate's chat; it starts dictation.
mobile_voice_discard: Screen reader label of the X button: drops the dictated text and leaves the message as it was.
mobile_voice_downloading_body: Body of the sheet when Android is still downloading the on-device language pack.
mobile_voice_engine: Screen reader text of the engine line under the dictation bar. {engine} is one of the three engine labels.
mobile_voice_engine_android: Engine label: speech is recognised by Android's on-device recognizer, nothing is sent.
mobile_voice_engine_apple: Engine label: speech is recognised by iOS on the phone, nothing is sent.
mobile_voice_engine_online: Engine label of the opt-in online recognizer: the phone's system service may send audio to Apple or Google.
mobile_voice_error_busy: Dictation error: another app holds the microphone.
mobile_voice_error_failed: Dictation error with no more specific cause.
mobile_voice_error_interrupted: Dictation error: the system took the microphone (call, alarm).
mobile_voice_error_language: Dictation error: the recognizer has no model for the language.
mobile_voice_error_permission: Dictation error: the microphone permission was revoked while dictating.
mobile_voice_insert: Screen reader label of the check button: puts the dictated text into the message. It never sends.
mobile_voice_listening: Label next to the live microphone dot while dictation records.
mobile_voice_mic_live: Screen reader label of the red dot that shows the microphone is live.
mobile_voice_mic_off: Label of the dictation bar after the microphone was released (time limit, app in the background) and the text waits for Insert or Discard.
mobile_voice_none_body: Body of the sheet when neither the on-device nor the system recognizer exists.
mobile_voice_nothing_heard: Message when dictation ended with no text.
mobile_voice_online_warning: Line under the opt-in button: what the person agrees to.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_off_hint: The way forward when the microphone is refused.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_off_title: Headline when the microphone is refused.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_off_what: What stops working without the microphone.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_private: What stays private about the microphone.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_restricted: Shown when a device policy forbids the microphone.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_title: Title of the explanation before the system asks for the microphone.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_unavailable_hint: The way around a missing microphone.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_unavailable_title: Headline when the phone has no microphone.
mobile_voice_perm_mic_why: One sentence: what the microphone is for.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_off_hint: The way forward when speech recognition is refused.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_off_title: Headline when speech recognition is refused.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_off_what: What stops working without speech recognition.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_private: What stays private about speech recognition.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_restricted: Shown when a device policy forbids speech recognition.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_title: Title of the explanation before iOS asks for speech recognition.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_unavailable_hin: The way around missing speech recognition.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_unavailable_tit: Headline when the phone cannot do speech recognition.
mobile_voice_perm_speech_why: One sentence: what speech recognition is for.
mobile_voice_placeholder: Dimmed hint in the dictation bar before the first words are recognised.
mobile_voice_read_aloud: Label of the chat switch that makes this phone read a crewmate's finished replies out loud (screen reader name)
mobile_voice_read_aloud_flag_failed: Snackbar when turning on read-aloud could not set spoken_replies on the crewmate; {reason} is the server's message
mobile_voice_read_aloud_hint: Screen reader hint of the read-aloud switch
mobile_voice_speaking: Indicator shown while the phone reads a reply aloud (a speaker, not the microphone dot)
mobile_voice_speaking_stop: Screen reader label of the Speaking indicator, which stops the voice when tapped
mobile_voice_starting: Shown for a moment after tapping Dictate, while the recognizer starts (it may install a language pack).
mobile_voice_unsupported_body: Body of the sheet: explains why on-device dictation is off and what the system recognizer costs.
mobile_voice_unsupported_title: Title of the sheet shown when the phone has no on-device recognizer for the app's language.
mobile_voice_use_online: Opt-in button of the sheet; the label says it is online.
